read_only_previous_test_precedent: previous PR50 24 test scenarios and already exposed labels are NEVER reused for tuning or fitting
objective: Train an action-conditioned relational world-model predicting H5/H20 per-robot per-task per-station per-resource future public state and a separate forecast of future newly visible/completed stages; test decision-aware training effects at same fixed completion-progress readout
scenario_source: PR48 BusinessSimulator and PR50 identical-prefix true candidate branch construction; no new environment mechanism claims; all data from new heldout seeds
anchor_rule: first real public tick>=7 with >=2 distinct legal CP-SAT candidate plans, <=70; no posthoc choosing the most informative tick
node_order: public current robots by id, public stations by id, currently observed task stages by (release_tick,id), public resources by id; future not-yet-visible task identities forbidden in model features
node_features: six observed public next-state channels per kind, masked when a previously visible node is absent from future observations
future_new_workload: Global number of newly visible/completed task stages at H5/H20 is a separate world-state event/count prediction target, NEVER a future node/ID in current graph
supervised_targets: global completed stage count H5/H20 for all visible and newly appearing stages
true first-action counterfactual makespan only as training decision signal
loss_note: Gradient-weighted arm is a fixed differentiable completion-sensitivity loss INSPIRED by VaGraM, not exact reproduction of official VaGraM; no test-driven value gradient fitting

training.validation_model_choice: lowest mean true candidate regret, then lower node-state MSE; selection before test; report all arm/seed metrics

ranking_rule: same frozen model-derived expected H20 COMPLETED STAGES for all arms; predicted current-task completed probabilities plus predicted anonymous new-stage completed count, no trainable Q/ranker
hard_requirements: All true branches follow identical public prefix and all legal candidate set fingerprints before intervention
All candidate true external disturbances generated by same business scenario seed, no future simulator events in input
No ground-truth task arrival table or future job identifiers in input
Never treat censored branch makespan as known full completion time
Decision-only gradient must enter learned relational transition weights
No published prior PR50 test samples in training or validation
No test-driven tuning or architecture selection
If global new stage outcome is missing, mark censored rather than fill zero
All snapshots and raw labels can be audited
caveat: New pilot same 7x5 map / three robot types / synthetic faults; H5/H20 anchored future entity predictions not autoregressive full-transition rollout; no claim GPU serving or actual company deployment.
